tagline: Walk the seams of the map, bank the signal, then buy the range to reach them

featuredCards.title: Glow Cloud (ALL HAIL)
featuredCards.caption: Every zone Cecil stands in makes this hit harder, and it hands a Broadcast token back on the way out. The deck's whole thesis on one card: get paid for where you stand.

featuredCards.title: Good Night, Night Vale. Good Night.
featuredCards.caption: Three copies of the biggest number in the deck, and the free three-space move after it is the engine — step onto fresh multi-zone ground and the tokens come to you.

featuredCards.title: Sheriff's Secret Police
featuredCards.caption: Why you bank the tokens: buy enough range to swing from outside their reach, and the boost they hid on their card gets counted onto yours instead.

featuredCards.title: They do not exist and you should not know about them
featuredCards.caption: The mind game. Declare any value you please — back it up from hand and their card's effects are cancelled with it, get caught inventing it and this is worth nothing at all.
